-----------------------------------------------------

Properties of a managed Cassandra cluster.

Used by: [CassandraCluster_Spec](#CassandraCluster_Spec).

| Property                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Type                                                                                                                                                       |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| authenticationMethod               | Which authentication method Cassandra should use to authenticate clients. `None` turns off authentication, so should not be used except in emergencies. `Cassandra` is the default password based authentication. The default is `Cassandra`.                                                                                                                                                                          | [AuthenticationMethod](#AuthenticationMethod)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                  |
| autoReplicate                      | The form of AutoReplicate that is being used by this cluster.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | [AutoReplicate](#AutoReplicate)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                |
| azureConnectionMethod              | How to connect to the azure services needed for running the cluster                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | [AzureConnectionType](#AzureConnectionType)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                    |
| backupSchedules                    | List of backup schedules that define when you want to back up your data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | [BackupSchedule[]](#BackupSchedule)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                            |
| cassandraAuditLoggingEnabled       | Whether Cassandra audit logging is enabled                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | bool<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                           |
| cassandraVersion                   | Which version of Cassandra should this cluster converge to running (e.g., 3.11). When updated, the cluster may take some time to migrate to the new version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                         |
| clientCertificates                 | List of TLS certificates used to authorize clients connecting to the cluster. All connections are TLS encrypted whether clientCertificates is set or not, but if clientCertificates is set, the managed Cassandra cluster will reject all connections not bearing a TLS client certificate that can be validated from one or more of the public certificates in this property.                                         | [Certificate[]](#Certificate)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                  |
| clusterNameOverride                | If you need to set the clusterName property in cassandra.yaml to something besides the resource name of the cluster, set the value to use on this property.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                         |
| delegatedManagementSubnetReference | Resource id of a subnet that this cluster's management service should have its network interface attached to. The subnet must be routable to all subnets that will be delegated to data centers. The resource id must be of the form '/&ZeroWidthSpace;subscriptions/&ZeroWidthSpace;<subscription id>/resourceGroups/<resource group>/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/<virtual network>/subnets/<subnet>' | [genruntime.ResourceReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#ResourceReference)<br/><small>Optional</small> |
| extensions                         | Extensions to be added or updated on cluster.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | string[]<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                       |
| externalDataCenters                | List of the data center names for unmanaged data centers in this cluster to be included in auto-replication.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | string[]<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                       |
| externalGossipCertificates         | List of TLS certificates used to authorize gossip from unmanaged data centers. The TLS certificates of all nodes in unmanaged data centers must be verifiable using one of the certificates provided in this property.                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [Certificate[]](#Certificate)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                  |
| externalSeedNodes                  | List of IP addresses of seed nodes in unmanaged data centers. | hoursBetweenBackups                | (Deprecated) Number of hours to wait between taking a backup of the cluster.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                            |
| initialCassandraAdminPassword      | Initial password for clients connecting as admin to the cluster. Should be changed after cluster creation. Returns null on GET. This field only applies when the authenticationMethod field is `Cassandra`.                                                                                                                                                                                                            | [genruntime.SecretReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#SecretReference)<br/><small>Optional</small>     |

| repairEnabled                      | Should automatic repairs run on this cluster? | restoreFromBackupReference         | To create an empty cluster, omit this field or set it to null. | authenticationMethod         | Which authentication method Cassandra should use to authenticate clients. `None` turns off authentication, so should not be used except in emergencies. `Cassandra` is the default password based authentication. The default is `Cassandra`.                                                                                                                                                                          | [AuthenticationMethod_STATUS](#AuthenticationMethod_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                           |
| autoReplicate                | The form of AutoReplicate that is being used by this cluster.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | [AutoReplicate_STATUS](#AutoReplicate_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                         |
| azureConnectionMethod        | How to connect to the azure services needed for running the cluster                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | [AzureConnectionType_STATUS](#AzureConnectionType_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                             |
| backupSchedules              | List of backup schedules that define when you want to back up your data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | [BackupSchedule_STATUS[]](#BackupSchedule_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                     |
| cassandraAuditLoggingEnabled | Whether Cassandra audit logging is enabled                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | bool<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                  |
| cassandraVersion             | Which version of Cassandra should this cluster converge to running (e.g., 3.11). When updated, the cluster may take some time to migrate to the new version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                |
| clientCertificates           | List of TLS certificates used to authorize clients connecting to the cluster. All connections are TLS encrypted whether clientCertificates is set or not, but if clientCertificates is set, the managed Cassandra cluster will reject all connections not bearing a TLS client certificate that can be validated from one or more of the public certificates in this property.                                         | Certificate_STATUS[]<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                  |
| clusterNameOverride          | If you need to set the clusterName property in cassandra.yaml to something besides the resource name of the cluster, set the value to use on this property.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                |
| deallocated                  | Whether the cluster and associated data centers has been deallocated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | bool<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                  |
| delegatedManagementSubnetId  | Resource id of a subnet that this cluster's management service should have its network interface attached to. The subnet must be routable to all subnets that will be delegated to data centers. The resource id must be of the form '/&ZeroWidthSpace;subscriptions/&ZeroWidthSpace;<subscription id>/resourceGroups/<resource group>/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/<virtual network>/subnets/<subnet>' | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                |
| extensions                   | Extensions to be added or updated on cluster.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | string[]<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                              |
| externalDataCenters          | List of the data center names for unmanaged data centers in this cluster to be included in auto-replication.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | string[]<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                              |
| externalGossipCertificates   | List of TLS certificates used to authorize gossip from unmanaged data centers. The TLS certificates of all nodes in unmanaged data centers must be verifiable using one of the certificates provided in this property.                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Certificate_STATUS[]<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                  |
| externalSeedNodes            | List of IP addresses of seed nodes in unmanaged data centers. These will be added to the seed node lists of all managed nodes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | [SeedNode_STATUS[]](#SeedNode_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                 |
| gossipCertificates           | List of TLS certificates that unmanaged nodes must trust for gossip with managed nodes. All managed nodes will present TLS client certificates that are verifiable using one of the certificates provided in this property.                                                                                                                                                                                            | Certificate_STATUS[]<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                  |
| hoursBetweenBackups          | (Deprecated) Number of hours to wait between taking a backup of the cluster.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                   |
| privateLinkResourceId        | If the Connection Method is Vpn, this is the Id of the private link resource that the datacenters need to connect to.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                |
| prometheusEndpoint           | Hostname or IP address where the Prometheus endpoint containing data about the managed Cassandra nodes can be reached.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [SeedNode_STATUS](#SeedNode_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                   |
| provisionError               | Error related to resource provisioning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | [CassandraError_STATUS](#CassandraError_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                       |
| provisioningState            | The status of the resource at the time the operation was called.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | [ManagedCassandraProvisioningState_STATUS](#ManagedCassandraProvisioningState_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small> |
| repairEnabled                | Should automatic repairs run on this cluster? If omitted, this is true, and should stay true unless you are running a hybrid cluster where you are already doing your own repairs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | bool<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                  |
| restoreFromBackupId          | To create an empty cluster, omit this field or set it to null. To restore a backup into a new cluster, set this field to the resource id of the backup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                |
| scheduledEventStrategy       | How the nodes in the cluster react to scheduled events                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [ScheduledEventStrategy_STATUS](#ScheduledEventStrategy_STATUS)<br/><small>Optional</small>                       |
| seedNodes                    | List of IP addresses of seed nodes in the managed data centers. DataCenterResourceProperties{#DataCenterResourceProperties}
-----------------------------------------------------------

Properties of a managed Cassandra data center.

Used by: [CassandraDataCenter_Spec](#CassandraDataCenter_Spec).

| Property                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Type                                                                                                                                                         |
|---------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| authenticationMethodLdapProperties    | Ldap authentication method properties. This feature is in preview.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | [AuthenticationMethodLdapProperties](#AuthenticationMethodLdapProperties)<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                        |
| availabilityZone                      | If the data center has Availability Zone support, apply it to the Virtual Machine ScaleSet that host the cassandra data center virtual machines.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | bool<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                             |
| backupStorageCustomerKeyUri           | Indicates the Key Uri of the customer key to use for encryption of the backup storage account.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                           |
| backupStorageCustomerKeyUriFromConfig | Indicates the Key Uri of the customer key to use for encryption of the backup storage account.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | [genruntime.ConfigMapReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#ConfigMapReference)<br/><small>Optional</small> |
| base64EncodedCassandraYamlFragment    | A fragment of a cassandra.yaml configuration file to be included in the cassandra.yaml for all nodes in this data center. The fragment should be Base64 encoded, and only a subset of keys are allowed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                           |
| dataCenterLocation                    | The region this data center should be created in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                           |
| delegatedSubnetReference              | Resource id of a subnet the nodes in this data center should have their network interfaces connected to. The subnet must be in the same region specified in `dataCenterLocation` and must be able to route to the subnet specified in the cluster's `delegatedManagementSubnetId` property. This resource id will be of the form '/&ZeroWidthSpace;subscriptions/&ZeroWidthSpace;<subscription id>/resourceGroups/<resource group>/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/<virtual network>/subnets/<subnet>'. | [genruntime.ResourceReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#ResourceReference)<br/><small>Optional</small>   |
| diskCapacity                          | Number of disks attached to each node. Default is 4.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                              |
| diskSku                               | Disk SKU used for data centers. Default value is P30.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                           |
| managedDiskCustomerKeyUriReference    | Key uri to use for encryption of managed disks. Ensure the system assigned identity of the cluster has been assigned appropriate permissions(key get/wrap/unwrap permissions) on the key.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | [genruntime.ResourceReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#ResourceReference)<br/><small>Optional</small>   |
| nodeCount                             | The number of nodes the data center should have. This is the desired number. After it is set, it may take some time for the data center to be scaled to match. To monitor the number of nodes and their status, use the fetchNodeStatus method on the cluster.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                              |
| privateEndpointIpAddress              | Ip of the VPN Endpoint for this data center.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                           |
| privateEndpointIpAddressFromConfig    | Ip of the VPN Endpoint for this data center.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | [genruntime.ConfigMapReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#ConfigMapReference)<br/><small>Optional</small> |
| sku                                   | Virtual Machine SKU used for data centers. Default value is Standard_DS14_v2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                           |

| Property                     | Description                                                                                                 | Type                                                                                                                                                   |

| connectionTimeoutInMs        | Timeout for connecting to the LDAP server in miliseconds. The default is 5000 ms.                           | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                        |
| searchBaseDistinguishedName  | Distinguished name of the object to start the recursive search of users from.                               | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                     |

| serverHostname               | Hostname of the LDAP server.                                                                                | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                     |
| serverPort                   | Port of the LDAP server.                                                                                    | int<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                        |
| serviceUserDistinguishedName | Distinguished name of the look up user account, who can look up user details on authentication.             | string<br/><small>Optional</small>                                                                                                                     |
| serviceUserPassword          | Password of the look up user.                                                                               | [genruntime.SecretReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-service-operator/v2/pkg/genruntime#SecretReference)<br/><small>Optional</small> |
